name: WonderEvents
short: Movie and game nights: RSVP buttons, Discord scheduled events, votes, reminders and attendance.
description: Staff run `.event create movie` and fill in a short form. The bot posts the event with the kind's ping role, Going / Maybe / Can't make it buttons and a time everyone sees in their own timezone, creates a native Discord Scheduled Event and a temporary per-event role (given on Going/Maybe, deleted when the event ends), posts a native vote for the movie/game, reminds only the people who said Going/Maybe an hour before, marks the event live at start and samples voice channels for the people who RSVP'd to record who actually came (`.event regulars`).
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores, per event, the user IDs of members who RSVP'd and how many minutes each member spent in voice while the event ran, plus a staff member's chosen timezone if they set one. It is deleted on a Red data-deletion request.
install_msg: Run `.event settings` (needs Manage Server) to open the settings panel and pick the events channel (e.g. #server-updates). movie, game and event kinds are built in; add more kinds or change an emoji/length in the same panel. Create events with `.event create movie`. The bot needs Manage Events for the Discord scheduled event.
author: evacfk
